-- From knowledge: PR threshold = 0.75, System Availability threshold = 95%
-- We need to find DISTINCT plants that meet BOTH criteria

-- First, let's see the join path from plants to operational_metrics and electrical_performance
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.sitetie) FROM plant_record pr;

-- Check how many distinct plants we have in the plants table
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants;

-- Test: find distinct plants that are both underperforming AND have chronic downtime
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.sitetie) 
FROM plant_record pr
JOIN electrical_performance ep ON pr.snapkey = ep.snaplink
WHERE CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio' AS numeric) < 0.75
  AND CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct' AS numeric) < 95;

-- Check what performance_ratio values look like
SELECT ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio' as pr, 
       ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct' as avail
FROM electrical_performance ep 
LIMIT 20;

-- Check how many have non-null PR and availability values
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio' IS NOT NULL AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio' != 'None') as has_pr,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct' AS numeric) < 95) as low_avail,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio' AS numeric) < 0.75) as low_pr

-- First, let's calculate OEI for a sample plant to verify the formula
-- OEI = (maintcost + cleancost + replcost) / P_rated(kW)
WITH plant_costs AS (
  SELECT pr.sitetie, 
         om.maintcost, om.cleancost, om.replcost,
         p.cap_mw,
         (om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost) / (p.cap_mw * 1000) as oei
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN operational_metrics om ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops
  JOIN plants p ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT * FROM plant_costs;

-- Check without converting to kW - using cap_mw directly
WITH plant_costs AS (
  SELECT pr.sitetie, 
         om.maintcost, om.cleancost, om.replcost,
         p.cap_mw,
         (om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost) / p.cap_mw as oei_mw
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN operational_metrics om ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops
  JOIN plants p ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT * FROM plant_costs;

-- Check distribution of OEI using cap_mw directly
SELECT 
  MIN((om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost) / p.cap_mw) as min_oei,
  MAX((om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost) / p.cap_mw) as max_oei,
  AVG((om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost) / p.cap_mw) as avg_oei,
